passages.provision_quote: The department shall identify and compile relevant educational materials and information for health care professionals and patients regarding maternal mental health conditions, including postpartum depression
passages.note: Signed law requires the health department to compile and distribute postpartum depression educational materials and creates a rural maternal-health advisory committee to study access and report findings, not a coverage or payer rule.
House Final Reading vote on HB2332, which addresses information distribution and a rural-care study committee rather than who government covers or pays for.
Bill status page names Willoughby as prime sponsor of HB2332, signed into law, a bill whose content does not address who government covers or pays for.

rows.reasoning: The only sourced record is HB2332, which Willoughby prime-sponsored and voted for; as enacted it requires the health department to compile and distribute postpartum depression educational materials and creates an advisory committee to study rural maternal health access and report findings, so it does not say whom government covers or helps pay for and is adjacent to 'What role should government play in healthcare access?'.
